name: Petal Panic
summary: The world has gotten weird, and only one gardener is equipped to clean it up. Play as Petal Pete in a stunning new C64 platformer that mixes tight arcade action with frantic flora-growing mechanics. Navigate through multi-stage worlds, outsmart bizarre enemies, and face off against screen-filling bosses by planting seeds, sprouting platforms, and fighting back with the power of nature. Remember the golden rule: Plant fast! Fight weird!
